item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-11-14 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 12 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (8). Barracuda Networks has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2026-18556 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 357 positions.
